Updated [app/page.tsx](/workspace/app/page.tsx) to fetch and render posts from `getPosts()`. The fetch uses Next.js Cache Components with a 3,600-second revalidation time and the `posts` tag for on-demand invalidation.

Enabled `cacheComponents` in [next.config.ts](/workspace/next.config.ts), which is required for these caching APIs. I did not run tests.
